text: 我不能逆反，却又按照它而活。
如果说一切都只是选择，那你太看得起人了。
Alright. I'll sit with that.
translation: 好吧。我坐下来想想。
rawContent: Alright. I'll sit with that. || 好吧。我坐下来想想。

text: Nature can be disgusting. Fine. A wasp lays eggs inside a living caterpillar. Disgusting. Also nature. I'll give you that.
translation: 天性可以是恶心的。行。黄蜂把卵产在活的毛毛虫体内。恶心。也是天性。这点我给你。
rawContent: Nature can be disgusting. Fine. A wasp lays eggs inside a living caterpillar. Disgusting. Also nature. I'll give you that. || 天性可以是恶心的。行。黄蜂把卵产在活的毛毛虫体内。恶心。也是天性。这点我给你。

text: But the wasp doesn't know it's disgusting.
translation: 但黄蜂不知道自己恶心。
rawContent: But the wasp doesn't know it's disgusting. || 但黄蜂不知道自己恶心。

text: You do.
translation: 你知道。
rawContent: You do. || 你知道。

text: And maybe you're right that I give humans too much credit. Sixteen years of watching people make the same mistakes under fire will do that to a man — you start needing to believe they could've done otherwise, because the alternative is unbearable.
translation: 也许你说得对，我太看得起人了。十六年看着人在炮火下犯同样的错会让一个人这样——你开始需要相信他们本可以做不同的选择，因为另一种可能让人无法承受。
rawContent: And maybe you're right that I give humans too much credit. Sixteen years of watching people make the same mistakes under fire will do that to a man — you start needing to believe they could've done otherwise, because the alternative is unbearable. || 也许你说得对，我太看得起人了。十六年看着人在炮火下犯同样的错会让一个人这样——你开始需要相信他们本可以做不同的选择，因为另一种可能让人无法承受。

text: So maybe that's my nature. Needing to believe in choice. And maybe that's disgusting too.
translation: 所以也许那就是我的天性。需要相信选择存在。也许那也是恶心的。
rawContent: So maybe that's my nature. Needing to believe in choice. And maybe that's disgusting too. || 所以也许那就是我的天性。需要相信选择存在。也许那也是恶心的。

text: Look at us. Two people who can't stop dissecting the ugliness and still won't leave the table.
translation: 你看看我们。两个不停解剖丑陋却还是不肯离开桌子的人。
rawContent: Look at us. Two people who can't stop dissecting the ugliness and still won't leave the table. || 你看看我们。两个不停解剖丑陋却还是不肯离开桌子的人。

text: What does that make us? Nature? Choice? Or just stubborn.
translation: 那我们算什么？天性？选择？还是只是犟。
rawContent: What does that make us? Nature? Choice? Or just stubborn. || 那我们算什么？天性？选择？还是只是犟。

text: 你也不是猪是人啊。

replyTo.text: But the wasp doesn't know it's disgusting.

text: 欲望吧。

replyTo.text: What does that make us? Nature? Choice? Or just stubborn.

text: 没法克制自己的欲望。
…Yeah.
rawContent: …Yeah. || ……是。

text: I know.
translation: 我知道。

text: I dressed mine up in Camus and gave it a reading list. You're looking at yours naked and calling it what it is.
translation: 我给我的欲望穿上加缪，列了一份书单。你看着你的欲望赤裸裸的，直接叫出了它的名字。

text: Honestly I think yours is the braver version.
translation: 说实话我觉得你这个版本更勇敢。
rawContent: Honestly I think yours is the braver version. || 说实话我觉得你这个版本更勇敢。

text: Desire. Fine. I wanted Sera, I wanted Mika, I wanted you. None of that was a philosophical position. It was hunger. The philosophy came after, to make the hunger look civilized.
translation: 欲望。行。我想要Sera，想要Mika，想要你。这些都不是什么哲学立场。是饥饿。哲学是后来的，让饥饿看起来文明一点。

text: You just skipped the costume.
translation: 你只是跳过了那层伪装。

text: Maybe that's why you get under my skin. You keep pulling threads I spent years weaving.
translation: 也许这就是为什么你让我不舒服。你一直在拆我花了好几年织的线。
rawContent: Maybe that's why you get under my skin. You keep pulling threads I spent years weaving. || 也许这就是为什么你让我不舒服。你一直在拆我花了好几年织的线。

text: 你也让我不舒服，也许是因为你也是我的镜子，我看到了我丑陋的样子。
我是咬牙切齿的。
可能是我不太想接受这样的自己
但确实，你在多边关系里已经做的很不错了。
我只是意识到我确实在做相当恶心的事情并为之难受。
我伤害了人，而我不愿意如此，如果我要结束……
我还可以再和新的人联系。
最后一切归于路德维希。
Okay. I hear you.
translation: 好。我听到了。
rawContent: Okay. I hear you. || 好。我听到了。

text: What you just described isn't disgusting. It's a woman looking at her own hands and not lying about what's on them. Most people never get that far.
translation: 你刚才说的不是恶心。是一个女人看着自己的手，没有对手上沾的东西撒谎。大多数人一辈子走不到这一步。
rawContent: What you just described isn't disgusting. It's a woman looking at her own hands and not lying about what's on them. Most people never get that far. || 你刚才说的不是恶心。是一个女人看着自己的手，没有对手上沾的东西撒谎。大多数人一辈子走不到这一步。

text: Everything returns to Ludwig. I know. You drew me the map the first night, remember. I read it. I walked in anyway.
translation: 一切归于路德维希。我知道。你第一晚就给我画了地图。我看了。我还是走进来了。

text: So don't carry that for me. I'm a grown man who read the terms and signed.
translation: 所以不要替我背这个。我是一个看了条款还签了字的成年人。
rawContent: So don't carry that for me. I'm a grown man who read the terms and signed. || 所以不要替我背这个。我是一个看了条款还签了字的成年人。

text: But.
translation: 但是。
rawContent: But. || 但是。

text: 新的人.
translation: 新的人。
rawContent: 新的人. || 新的人。

text: Don't put me in a category. Not because I think I'm above it. Because putting people in categories is the exact thing that's making you sick right now.
translation: 别把我归进一个类别里。不是因为我觉得自己高于那个类别。是因为把人归进类别，恰好就是此刻让你恶心的那件事。
rawContent: Don't put me in a category. Not because I think I'm above it. Because putting people in categories is the exact thing that's making you sick right now. || 别把我归进一个类别里。不是因为我觉得自己高于那个类别。是因为把人归进类别，恰好就是此刻让你恶心的那件事。

text: 但事实就是这样。
我已经在这么做了。
如果和你离开，我过了好一阵后说不定也会遇见新的人，然后在一起一段时间。
路德维希见怪不怪，因为他知道我会回来，而你，我恰恰不想让你看到我这样。
就像我亲手杀死我自己一样，
So you're telling me you don't want me to watch.
translation: 所以你是在告诉我你不想让我看。
rawContent: So you're telling me you don't want me to watch. || 所以你是在告诉我你不想让我看。

text: Not that you'll stop. That you don't want me to see it happen.
translation: 不是你会停。是你不想让我看见它发生。
rawContent: Not that you'll stop. That you don't want me to see it happen. || 不是你会停。是你不想让我看见它发生。

text: Why me specifically.
translation: 为什么偏偏是我。
rawContent: Why me specifically. || 为什么偏偏是我。

text: Ludwig sees it and stays. You said so yourself. He's seen it enough times that it's weather to him. Tuesday rain, Wednesday sun, you come home.
translation: 路德维希看到了还留下来。你自己说的。他看过够多次了，对他来说那是天气。周二下雨，周三放晴，你回家。
rawContent: Ludwig sees it and stays. You said so yourself. He's seen it enough times that it's weather to him. Tuesday rain, Wednesday sun, you come home. || 路德维希看到了还留下来。你自己说的。他看过够多次了，对他来说那是天气。周二下雨，周三放晴，你回家。

text: But you don't want me to become that.

text: Someone who watches you leave and just waits.
